messages.content: How have you been feeling in general lately? Has your mood been pretty steady, or has it been kind of all over the place?
It's been all over the place. Some days I feel like I can handle things, and then the next day I just want to crawl back into bed. I don't know what's wrong with me.
I hear you. When you think about what's coming up — whether it's next week, next month, or further ahead — how do you generally feel about it?
I don't know if I can do it. It all feels so big and overwhelming. I just want to stop and start over, but I don't know how to make that happen.
I appreciate you telling me that. What kinds of things do you find yourself enjoying these days? Hobbies, time with people, specific activities — what brings you a sense of satisfaction?
Honestly? Nothing. I used to love hiking, but now it just feels like a chore. I don't have the energy for it. I don't even know what I used to like about it.
I appreciate you telling me that. Do you find it easy to focus on things — work, reading, conversations? Or has it been harder to concentrate lately?
It’s hard. I try to read a book, but I get two pages in and I forget what I was reading. I have to re-read it three times just to get through a paragraph. It’s really frustrating.
That sounds really tough. How has your sleep been? Are you sleeping okay, having trouble falling asleep, or waking up too early?
I wake up in the middle of the night and can't go back to sleep. I just lie there and think about everything I've done wrong. It’s like my mind is replaying all the mistakes.
Thanks for being so open. Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or eating habits lately? More, less, or about the same?
I don't really eat much anymore. I don't taste the food, so it doesn't matter. It’s just fuel for my body.
Thanks for being so open. Have you found yourself getting more emotional than usual? Like tearing up or crying more often?
Yeah. I cry a lot. It’s embarrassing, but I just feel like I’m at the end of my rope and I don't know how to climb back up.
Thank you for sharing that. How do you feel about yourself overall? Are you generally okay with who you are, or do you find yourself being quite critical?
I don't like who I am right now. I feel like I've let everyone down, including myself. I just wish I could go back and do things differently.
I appreciate you telling me that. Have you noticed yourself getting annoyed or irritated more easily than usual? Like snapping at people or feeling on edge?
Yeah. I get annoyed at everything. The traffic, the mailman... it’s like nothing is going right, so I just get angry.
That sounds really tough. Have you been spending time with people, or has that kind of taken a back seat? How's your social life feeling?
I don't want to see anyone. They can't help me, so I just stay away. I don't want to be a burden.
I appreciate you telling me that. Do you find yourself feeling guilty a lot? About things you've done, or sometimes just in general?
Yeah. I feel guilty all the time. I wish I could just go back and do it all differently, but I can't.
Thanks for being so open. How's your energy level been? Are you able to tackle tasks and activities, or do you find yourself dragging?
I’m exhausted all the time. Even when I'm sitting still, I'm tired. It’s like I’m just running on fumes.

It sounds like you're carrying a lot right now, and being constantly exhausted must make everything feel even harder. When you're faced with decisions, even small ones, how easy or difficult is it for you to make up your mind these days? Do you find yourself second-guessing a lot, or feeling stuck about what to do?
I just freeze. I look at the choices and I can't pick one. I just stand there until someone else makes the decision for me.

It sounds incredibly draining to feel so stuck and exhausted all the time. You mentioned replaying mistakes in your mind – do you find yourself being pretty hard on yourself in general, or is that something that’s become more frequent lately?
I’m just hard on myself all the time. I don't know how to stop. I just wish I could be okay with who I am, but I’m not.

Thank you so much for sharing all of this with me. It takes a lot of courage to be so open, and I really appreciate you taking the time to talk. I hope you're able to find some moments of peace and kindness for yourself soon.
